scope: Creator onboarding, admin roster, agreement, creator experience, tests, and Firebase rules truth-lane inventory.

doctrine.canonicalSource: creator_onboarding/{uid} is the canonical creator intake, legal, ID, approval, owner override, synthetic creator, and role activation source. creator_onboarding/{uid}/history/{eventId} is the canonical lifecycle audit trail.
doctrine.projectionSource: creator_review_queue/{uid} is the admin roster projection. users/{uid}.creatorApplication is a creator-facing and legacy-compatible projection for waitlist routing/status.
doctrine.legacySource: Any new code that treats users/{uid}.creatorApplication as the canonical source after creator_onboarding/{uid} exists is forbidden.
doctrine.creatorExperienceSource: users/{uid}.creatorSettings and users/{uid}.creatorRestrictions are the current canonical creator fan-experience settings shape; fan relationship, subscription, request, booking, payout, broadcast, and message records live in CREATOR_COLLECTIONS.

inventory.responsibility: Defines the creator onboarding target model, legacy snapshot normalizers, canonical record, user projection, review queue projection, blocking reasons, history event types, and human-readable history labels.
inventory.risk: Shared helper still carries legacy/projection compatibility in the same file as canonical typing, so future contributors can mistake projection helpers for the source of truth.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep this as the contract owner, but keep comments explicit that creator_onboarding is canonical and users.creatorApplication is projection only.

inventory.responsibility: Server materializer for creator submissions; writes creator_onboarding, creator_review_queue, users.creatorApplication projection, and onboarding history in transactions.
inventory.risk: This is the critical dual-write bridge; drift here can desync canonical onboarding, roster projection, and user projection.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep dual-write centralized here until legacy projection consumers are migrated. Do not add independent creatorApplication writes elsewhere.

inventory.responsibility: Reads canonical onboarding, review queue, and user projection snapshots to find missing queue rows, missing canonical records, projection-only records, role mismatches, and ID metadata issues.
inventory.risk: Diagnostics depend on all three lanes and are the main safety net for projection/canonical drift.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep reporting projection_without_source until every creatorApplication-only record is migrated or intentionally archived.

inventory.responsibility: Sends deduped admin notifications for creator onboarding events; does not own creator source data.
inventory.risk: Notification dispatch can make a creator lane appear acted on even if canonical materialization failed elsewhere.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep notification dispatch dependent on canonical submission outcomes and preserve dedupe locks.

inventory.responsibility: Creator signup entrypoint; calls ensureCreatorOnboardingSubmission for creator intent and returns creatorApplication projection to the client.
inventory.risk: Signup response uses projection language because client routing still expects creatorApplication.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep using ensureCreatorOnboardingSubmission; future client response can add canonical onboarding metadata but must not bypass the server materializer.

inventory.responsibility: Creator self-service application update route; reads existing user projection, writes canonical onboarding and projections through sync helpers, and writes history.
inventory.risk: Legacy projection fallback is still used to bootstrap canonical state when needed.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep all writes routed through syncCreatorOnboardingDocuments and remove projection bootstrap only after migration tooling confirms no projection-only records remain.

inventory.responsibility: Creator intro acknowledgement route; writes canonical onboarding state, user projection, review queue projection, and intro history.
inventory.risk: Intro state must remain canonical-first or Admin Roster action labels will drift.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep intro updates on creator_onboarding and projection sync in the same transaction.

inventory.responsibility: Creator ID submission route; writes ID evidence to canonical onboarding/projections and lifecycle history.
inventory.risk: Sensitive ID evidence must not be copied into public-facing creator profile surfaces.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep ID details in canonical/debug paths and project only review-safe status fields.

inventory.responsibility: Creator agreement signature route; requires dispatch/version/hash, writes signature evidence under creator_onboarding, updates canonical/projection state, and writes contract history.
inventory.risk: Legal evidence must preserve prior signatures and exact agreement hash/version.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Do not write signature evidence outside creator_onboarding agreement subcollections; preserve versioned dispatch records.

inventory.responsibility: Creator-scoped agreement document read route; reads canonical onboarding agreement template/dispatch state.
inventory.risk: Raw storage paths must not leak to creators.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep document reads scoped to the authenticated creator and expose source availability rather than raw paths.

inventory.responsibility: Admin roster API; reads user projections, creator review queue, creator collections, and writes synthetic/manual creator onboarding canonical/projection/queue/history.
inventory.risk: Roster uses queue projection for speed but still falls back to user projection for hidden or legacy entries.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep admin creation and synthetic creation on canonical sync helpers; migrate roster reads to queue/canonical first and projection fallback second.

inventory.responsibility: Admin user mutation route; can apply creatorApplication patches by rebuilding canonical onboarding, syncing projections, and writing status-change history.
inventory.risk: Generic admin user updates can become a legacy backdoor if future code writes creatorApplication directly.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep creatorApplication patches wrapped by canonical rebuild/sync and prefer narrower creator admin routes for new actions.

inventory.responsibility: Admin-on-behalf account controls for profile, email, password reset/temp password, role, status, notification quick edit, and creator approval account state; writes creator onboarding history where applicable.
inventory.risk: Account controls can cross user profile truth, creator role activation, and creator onboarding approval truth in one action.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep elevated account controls server-only, actor-marked, and history-backed. Do not let account controls write creatorApplication without canonical sync.

inventory.responsibility: Admin ID document review route; updates canonical creator onboarding ID status, projections, and history.
inventory.risk: ID review is sensitive and must not leak document metadata into public projection fields.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep review actions on canonical onboarding, project only status/safe summaries, and preserve reviewer history.

inventory.responsibility: Admin creator view-as simulation audit route; writes onboarding/admin history for view-as start/end without replacing auth identity.
inventory.risk: View-as must not become real session takeover or wallet/payment impersonation.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep view-as as simulation context with explicit performedAs markers and history events.

inventory.responsibility: Admin user detail API; reads user projection, canonical onboarding, onboarding history, and creator collection counts for Debug/user detail.
inventory.risk: Fallback canonical reconstruction from creatorApplication can mask projection-only records if Debug does not surface it.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep returning both canonical and projection fields until Admin Debug can explicitly flag fallback canonical reconstruction.

inventory.responsibility: Admin Roster client surface; consumes creatorReviewQueue, selected creator canonical/projection detail, history, agreement state, account controls, fan settings, and telemetry.
inventory.risk: Large UI surface still shows projection and canonical values together; wrong precedence can mislead operators.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep canonical selected detail as primary and use user.creatorApplication only as explicit projection fallback.

inventory.responsibility: Pure Admin Roster decision queue classifier, action label mapper, section key model, and roster telemetry payload helper.
inventory.risk: Queue classification depends on projected statuses remaining in parity with canonical onboarding.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep this pure and backed by tests; do not add Firestore reads or side effects.

inventory.responsibility: Collapsed Admin Roster audit trail viewer for creator_onboarding history entries.
inventory.risk: If raw enum labels leak into primary UI, operators may misunderstand lifecycle truth.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep latest-three compaction and Details disclosure; Debug can carry raw metadata.

inventory.responsibility: Legacy/projection adapter for users.creatorApplication normalization, initial projection construction, creator navigation state, and fan onboarding bypass decisions.
inventory.risk: This file name and helpers can make projection state feel canonical to future code.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Treat as a projection/legacy adapter only; new creator lifecycle logic must use creator_onboarding helpers.

inventory.responsibility: Shared database-facing TypeScript types for CreatorApplication projection, CreatorSettings, CreatorRestrictions, UserProfile, and synthetic creator markers.
inventory.risk: Type presence alone does not express whether a field is canonical or projection.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep doc comments and inventory clear that CreatorApplication is projection/legacy-compatible while CreatorSettings/CreatorRestrictions are current fan-experience settings.

inventory.responsibility: Static creator intro and master service agreement version/section text constants.
inventory.risk: Static constants are not enough for active template/version evidence if agreement manager state exists.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Use as fallback/native full text source; active agreement lifecycle should stay in creator agreement template/dispatch helpers.

inventory.responsibility: Agreement template, dispatch, signature, hash, source, and debug field types/helpers.
inventory.risk: Agreement hash/version must stay immutable for signed records.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep agreement evidence versioned and do not mirror full legal source into users.creatorApplication beyond status/projection fields.

inventory.responsibility: Server agreement dispatch and countersign operations; writes dispatch/signature subcollections, canonical onboarding fields, user projection, review queue, and history.
inventory.risk: Agreement updates can invalidate current creator signature if not tied to dispatch/hash.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep dispatch/version/hash as the evidence boundary and use agreement_update_sent history for re-sign flows.

inventory.responsibility: Server active agreement template lookup, save, and activation history under creator_agreement_templates.
inventory.risk: Template activation affects future creators and must remain owner/admin guarded.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep active template version/hash separate from already-signed creator records.

inventory.responsibility: Admin agreement template, send, update-send, countersign, and preview route.
inventory.risk: Admin legal actions need target user, version, hash, and actor evidence.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep all agreement lifecycle writes on creator_onboarding/creator_agreement_templates and avoid direct projection edits.

inventory.responsibility: Creator-facing structured agreement review and acknowledgement/signature UI.
inventory.risk: Visible status copy must not expose raw legal enum names or imply activation before admin completion.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep UI state fed by canonical agreement dispatch/version/hash readiness.

inventory.responsibility: Creator fan-experience settings, restrictions, pricing defaults, collection names, relationship IDs, and lane availability helpers.
inventory.risk: Settings defaults can be mistaken for stored creator settings if source labels are lost.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep this as the single settings/restrictions model; do not create parallel fan experience settings.

inventory.responsibility: Server sanitizers and economics helpers for creator fan-experience settings/restrictions and accrual calculations.
inventory.risk: Server sanitizers must remain aligned with the client-facing settings shape.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep server update merge helpers importing the canonical CreatorSettings/CreatorRestrictions model.

inventory.responsibility: Creator self-service settings/restrictions route; reads/writes users.creatorSettings and users.creatorRestrictions and reads creator ops/count collections.
inventory.risk: Route allows own-account settings but admin restriction updates must remain explicitly marked.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep settings writes on the existing CreatorSettings/CreatorRestrictions shape and maintain actor markers for restrictions.

inventory.responsibility: Admin-on-behalf fan experience settings route; writes user creatorSettings/restrictions, history, debug metadata, and telemetry.
inventory.risk: Fan experience writes live on users while audit history lives under creator_onboarding.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep the settings model on users unless a future migration explicitly moves creator experience settings and writes migration adapters.

inventory.responsibility: Fan-facing panel for Fan Pass, private chat, custom requests, and live time; consumes CreatorSettings, user balance, lane restrictions, and lane telemetry.
inventory.risk: Fan panel can show default settings as if creator-specific settings were loaded if source is not clear.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep settings/restrictions passed from the public creator profile and preserve telemetry/debug source markers.

inventory.responsibility: Creator follow/relationship route; reads public creator user profile including creatorApplication projection for approval gating and writes creator_relationships plus creator_ops counters.
inventory.risk: Public creator availability still reads approval through user projection.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Prefer role/public-profile eligibility for public routes and use creatorApplication only as projection fallback.

inventory.responsibility: Fan Pass route; reads creatorSettings/restrictions and writes creator_subscriptions, ledger accruals, and transactions.
inventory.risk: Monetized fan experience relies on users.creatorSettings being accurate and server-authoritative.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep billing/economy truth out of creator onboarding projection lanes.

inventory.responsibility: Custom request route; reads creatorSettings/restrictions and writes creator_custom_requests, ledger accruals, and transactions.
inventory.risk: Request lane must not use client-provided price as truth.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep pricing derived from CreatorSettings categories server-side.

inventory.responsibility: Live time booking route; reads creatorSettings/restrictions/subscription state and writes creator_call_bookings, ledger accruals, and transactions.
inventory.risk: Availability and rate calculations must remain server-side.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep booking settings normalized through CreatorSettings and test subscriber discount/rate paths.

inventory.responsibility: Legacy creator messages compatibility route; reads user/creator context and writes/reads creator chat through chat server helpers.
inventory.risk: Compatibility route is explicitly legacy and can obscure native chat truth if not separated.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep compatibility headers/removal target and migrate callers to native chat paths.

inventory.responsibility: Creator broadcast route; reads creatorSettings/restrictions, relationships/subscriptions, and writes creator_broadcasts plus notifications.
inventory.risk: Broadcasts can notify followers/subscribers; duplicate prevention must stay separate from onboarding truth.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep broadcast enablement tied to creatorRestrictions and notification dedupe.

inventory.responsibility: Creator payout request route; reads creator payout restrictions and ledger accruals, writes payout requests.
inventory.risk: Payout restrictions are creator experience settings, not onboarding approval.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep payout restriction truth in creatorRestrictions and payout records in CREATOR_COLLECTIONS.

inventory.responsibility: Creator drop submission route; reads creator role/restrictions and writes drops submitted by creators.
inventory.risk: Creator role activation and dropSubmissionsRestricted must remain server-authoritative.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep route gated by role/restrictions; do not infer creator access from creatorApplication alone.

inventory.responsibility: Creator drop asset upload helper route; reads creator role/restrictions before allowing asset operations.
inventory.risk: Asset upload must not be enabled for unapproved or restricted creators.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep role/restriction gating server-side and storage paths entitlement-safe.

inventory.responsibility: Creator discovery route for public/creator lists.
inventory.risk: Public discovery should expose only public-safe creator data.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep discovery output independent of private onboarding/legal fields.

inventory.responsibility: Public creator profile route; reads public creator user profile, creatorSettings, relationships, and drops.
inventory.risk: Public route must not leak onboarding/legal/debug details.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep public profile payload limited to role/status/profile/settings/drop public data.

inventory.responsibility: Public creator profile helpers; currently uses creatorApplication approval projection when resolving public creator visibility.
inventory.risk: Projection-based public visibility can diverge from canonical approval if sync fails.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Future cleanup should use role/public-profile state first and only use creatorApplication as a documented projection fallback.

inventory.responsibility: Firestore client rules; creator_message_threads and creator_messages are participant/admin readable and client writes are denied.
inventory.risk: No direct client rules are present for creator_onboarding or creator_review_queue; those are server/admin surfaces by omission.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep creator_onboarding, creator_review_queue, creator relationships, requests, bookings, subscriptions, and payouts server-mediated unless explicit client rules are added with tests.

inventory.responsibility: Realtime Database rules audited; no creator onboarding, review queue, or creator relationship paths were detected in this file.
inventory.risk: Creator lane currently appears Firestore/server-mediated, but future RTDB paths would need explicit classification.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Document any future creator RTDB path before adding it and include role-boundary tests.

inventory.responsibility: Storage rules audited; no creator_onboarding, creator_review_queue, or creatorApplication paths were detected by this pass.
inventory.risk: Creator ID and agreement source paths are sensitive even when storage rules do not name them directly.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep protected creator legal/ID media behind server routes or explicit storage rules tests before adding client access.

inventory.responsibility: Unit coverage for creator onboarding status normalization, canonical record normalization, history entry normalization, and event labels.
inventory.risk: Tests must continue to assert projection compatibility without blessing projection as canonical.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Add migration assertions if creatorApplication fallback is removed later.

inventory.responsibility: Server materializer coverage for creator_onboarding, creator_review_queue, users.creatorApplication, and deterministic history writes.
inventory.risk: This is the main regression guard for dual-write drift.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep this test close to any future projection cleanup.

inventory.responsibility: Admin roster API coverage for queue/projection materialization, admin creation, and roster payloads.
inventory.risk: Roster tests should catch projection/canonical precedence regressions.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep explicit queue/canonical/projection fixtures.

inventory.responsibility: Admin user update route coverage including creatorApplication patch canonical sync.
inventory.risk: Generic user route can regress into direct projection writes.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep test expectations on canonical sync and role/owner boundaries.

inventory.responsibility: Registration route coverage for creator signup calling ensureCreatorOnboardingSubmission and returning projection state.
inventory.risk: Signup tests must keep creator onboarding materialization mandatory for creator intent.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep notification dedupe and telemetry assertions tied to canonical submission.

inventory.responsibility: Coverage for creator fan-experience settings, restrictions, pricing, defaults, and helper behavior.
inventory.risk: Fan experience settings must remain one model.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep this test in the fan settings signoff lane.

inventory.responsibility: Fan-facing creator experience panel render and telemetry coverage.
inventory.risk: Panel can regress to generic defaults or missing telemetry if settings source changes.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep telemetry and copy tests alongside settings source tests.

inventory.responsibility: Agreement template, dispatch, signature, hash, and debug field helper coverage.
inventory.risk: Agreement evidence integrity depends on version/hash helpers.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep prior-signature preservation tests whenever agreement templates change.

inventory.responsibility: Admin Roster audit trail compaction and expansion coverage.
inventory.risk: Audit trail UI can become overwhelming or leak raw metadata if compaction fails.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep latest-three and Details disclosure assertions.

inventory.responsibility: Diagnostics coverage for canonical/projection/queue discrepancy detection.
inventory.risk: Diagnostics can hide projection-only legacy debt if coverage weakens.
inventory.cleanupRecommendation: Keep projection_without_source and missing_queue fixtures.

cleanupPlan: Keep creator_onboarding/{uid} as canonical for intake/legal/ID/approval/owner/synthetic/role activation state.
Keep creator_onboarding/{uid}/history/{eventId} as canonical audit trail; do not create a parallel audit collection.
Keep creator_review_queue/{uid} as a derived Admin Roster projection and regenerate it through sync helpers.
Keep users/{uid}.creatorApplication as creator-facing and legacy-compatible projection until all routing and waitlist consumers are migrated.
Flag every projection-only creatorApplication record in Admin Debug diagnostics until migrated or intentionally archived.
Keep creator experience settings on users/{uid}.creatorSettings and users/{uid}.creatorRestrictions unless a dedicated migration deliberately creates a new canonical source.
Remove or kill-switch the legacy creator messages compatibility route only after native chat callers are proven complete.
Add future migrations as explicit adapter cleanup passes with tests for queue/canonical/projection parity.
forbiddenFuturePatterns: Do not treat users/{uid}.creatorApplication as canonical when creator_onboarding/{uid} exists.
Do not write users.creatorApplication directly outside centralized creator onboarding sync helpers.
Do not create a second creator intake or audit collection while creator_onboarding/{uid}/history exists.
Do not make public creator routes read private onboarding/legal/ID metadata.
Do not create a parallel CreatorSettings model for fan experiences.
